items.title: Horace "One Leg Horse" White Interview, 1961-03-03
items.q: Man and Perez would come and get me... I used to play with them little bands around

ctx.x: I used to play with them little bands around, little different bands. Sometimes I used to play, sometimes I'd be short of a drummer. Man and Perez would come and get me. Man and Perez would say, all of us. I'd say, what? Come on, get your... I used to get my black. That time I used to have a black shirt, white band, a black shirt, black band, and a white shirt, and a tie, and my cap. Well, my cap used to be the old Ricker. Used to be the old Ricker band. I used to be with the old Rick in them. I used to be with…
What was the first band you ever heard in person that you remember?
